svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make four. Cut 220 x 220 mm from 10 mm plate; square; deburr.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Four 18 mm holes on a 160 mm square: 30 mm in from each edge.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Galvanize after drilling, or touch up with zinc-rich paint.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: lies on the slab; the post stands on its centre between two

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: base cleats; the four M16 anchors pass through cleat and plate.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Use the drilled plate as the template for the slab holes.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the plate sits flat on the slab without rocking; pack with

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: steel shims or bedding grout if the slab is out of level.
